label: Modal ontological argument on the case profile gives a necessary concretum
meaning: On one case signature σ, profile m and standpoint w. All five inputs are supplied premises; nothing is derived about them. The possibility premise gives an accessible world v with a concrete GOD_4. The boxed conditional at w makes G (some concrete GOD_4 exists) necessary at v. Euclidean access at w only (1b1462e6) gives v access to every world accessible from w, so G holds at all of them: a de dicto box, whose witnesses may differ. Reflexivity at w (2b20b5af) gives a concrete GOD_4 x existing at w, and the rigidity bridge identifies every GOD_4 witness at an accessible world with x, so x exists at every accessible world. The conclusion NecessaryConcreteAt (b19ffd92) takes that same x with its concreteness, existence at w and NecessaryAt at w; x's GOD_4-hood is used to apply the bridge but is not part of the conclusion. Concreteness and GOD_4-hood come only from the possibility premise. Neither Scott's nor Gödel's NecessaryExistence is used, so no Gödel–Scott sense or God concept is identified with GOD_4. No excluded middle. SuccessorConnected (0523281a) is the exact frame condition for the forward escalation over all G; EuclideanAt is used because it is already a root-path premise and the proof needs only one successor step. The controls show each of the three new premises is needed and that the conclusion does not entail the bridge.
